<script>
const reveals=[...document.querySelectorAll('.reveal')];
if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
 const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('on');io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.08,rootMargin:'40px 0px'});
 reveals.forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
} else reveals.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('on'));
const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item')];
const sections=[...document.querySelectorAll('.rank-section')];
const nio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
 es.filter(e=>e.isIntersecting).sort((a,b)=>b.intersectionRatio-a.intersectionRatio).slice(0,1).forEach(e=>{
   const id=e.target.id;items.forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('active',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+id));
 });
},{rootMargin:'-30% 0px -58% 0px',threshold:[0,.1,.5]});
sections.forEach(s=>nio.observe(s));
</script>
